section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the findings of the study, highlighting that a two-factor structure (General Body Appreciation and Body Image Investment) of the BAS was found among Malaysian women, contrasting with Western samples. It suggests cross-cultural differences in positive body image and cautions against using a single overall BAS score for different cultural groups. The study also found a significant negative correlation between General Body Appreciation and BMI, consistent with previous research.
